mapper.select: SELECT op.wo_op_id, op.wo_no, op.seq, op.process_code, p.process_name, op.wc_code, op.status, op.good_qty, op.defect_qty, op.started_at, wo.item_code, i.item_name, wo.plan_qty, wo.due_date, wo.status AS wo_status, prev.good_qty AS prev_good_qty FROM work_order_operation op JOIN work_order wo ON wo.wo_no = op.wo_no JOIN item i ON i.item_code = wo.item_code JOIN process p ON p.process_code = op.process_code LEFT JOIN work_order_operation prev ON prev.wo_no = op.wo_no AND prev.seq = (SELECT MAX(x.seq) FROM work_order_operation x WHERE x.wo_no = op.wo_no AND x.seq < op.seq) WHERE op.wc_code = #{wcCode} AND op.status IN ('WAIT', 'RUN') AND wo.status IN ('WAIT', 'RUN') ORDER BY CASE op.status WHEN 'RUN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, wo.due_date, wo.wo_no
